_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Coil base rate (only 7% of windows ±2) plus cancelled springs leave no breaker; drift into Complacency is the honest next rung if F&G stays neutral and momentum stays flat.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst explicit HOLD to Complacency; narrative distributional tone without matching HOLD call
next_move.confirmed_if: BTC drifts inside range, fear_greed pinned ~45-55, funding near flat, 30d momentum does not expand
next_move.invalidated_if: ETF flows reverse with momentum breakout up, or fear_greed breaks ~40 with negative funding and range failure
